summary: A multi-line text field, like you'd use for a comment or message.
description: A MozInputText subclass rendering a native <textarea> instead of an <input>, adding a rows property (default 2) for the number of visible text rows.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text of the label element. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the textarea control. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the textarea control. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: The number of visible text rows, reflected as an attribute. Declared directly on MozTextarea, not inherited.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The disabled state of the textarea control. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: The readonly state of the textarea control.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The required state of the textarea control.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Text for the description element that helps describe the textarea control. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of the SUMO support page to link to (attribute: support-page). Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text to display when the textarea has no value.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label text when there is no visible label. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: ariaDescription
attributes.description: The aria-description text when there is no visible description. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title attribute, mapped onto the inner textarea. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: accessKey
attributes.description: Mapped accesskey attribute. Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: inputLayout
attributes.description: Internal layout mode ("inline" | "block" | "inline-end"); moz-input-text overrides the base default to "block". Inherited via MozInputText.

attributes.name: parentDisabled
attributes.description: Internal: set by a parent input/fieldset to cascade a disabled state. Inherited via MozInputText.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Rendered when the description property is unset, letting callers supply richer description markup.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Rendered when supportPage is unset, letting callers supply a custom support link element.

events.name: input
events.description: Native input event as the user types; handled internally (inherited handleInput) to update value.

events.name: change
events.description: Redispatched from the native textarea's change event so it crosses the shadow boundary.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The internal <label is="moz-label">, inherited from MozBaseInputElement's shared render().

cssParts.name: support-link
cssParts.description: The optional support link, inherited from MozBaseInputElement's shared render().
